about.statement: Small team, high standard, shipped work.
story: Rhine Solution is a two-person studio led by a CEO/CTO pair who build together. We make custom web experiences — portfolios, portals, and products — from first sketch to live deploy.
Our workflow is AI-first but human-led. The Mac Mini runs our agents and models, and the Obsidian Brain keeps every decision documented and repeatable.
We favor simplicity, craft, and production code. When we promise a project, it ships.

values.title: Craft over quantity
values.text: We take on a few projects and finish them properly.

values.title: Simplicity wins
values.text: Clear structure, pure CSS, no unnecessary dependencies.

values.title: AI-assisted, human-led
values.text: Agents and models speed us up; people make the calls.

values.title: Documented, always
values.text: Every decision lives in the Brain, not in someone's head.

values.title: Own the outcome
values.text: Our own infrastructure, our own code, end to end.
